# Apache HTTPD (AJP) — custom-to-root-context-push-location

AJP custom-to-root-context where PUSH bypasses AJP in dedicated blocks: `<Location /app/VAADIN/push>` maps to the backend's /VAADIN/push over HTTP with `upgrade=websocket`, everything else goes over AJP.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/app/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Apache HTTPD config (`vaadin.conf`):

```apache
# PUSH bypasses AJP, which cannot carry WebSocket frames: the push paths get
# their own HTTP block with upgrade=websocket and everything else goes over
# AJP, so SSE and long-polling push travel over HTTP too.
# The custom-to-root-context sibling does it the other way round, with a
# server-scope RewriteRule that sends every upgrade request to a ws:// worker.
#
# Push sits at its default location: the browser asks for /app/VAADIN/push,
# which reaches /VAADIN/push on the backend. VAADIN_PUSH_URL cannot move it:
# the variable has been ignored since Flow 23 (issue #43).
#
# http:// with upgrade=websocket rather than ws://: since httpd 2.4.47 that
# upgrades only when the client asks for one, so the same block carries
# WebSocket, SSE and long polling. A ws:// worker serves WebSocket only, and
# SSE both streams from and POSTs its client-to-server messages to this path.

<Location /app/ >
    ProxyPass         ajp://vaadin:8009/ flushpackets=on
    ProxyPassReverse  /
    ProxyPassReverseCookiePath "/" "/app"
</Location>

<Location /app/VAADIN/push>
    ProxyPass               http://vaadin:8080/VAADIN/push upgrade=websocket
</Location>

<Location /app/HILLA/push>
    ProxyPass               http://vaadin:8080/HILLA/push upgrade=websocket
</Location>
```
